hero.title: German precision and Brazilian technical expertise serving high-demand industry.
hero.description: Located at the SENAI Ítalo Bologna Faculty in Goiânia, the Center for Excellence in Metrology is the result of a strategic alliance between the FIEG System / SENAI Goiás and Carl Zeiss. We operate as one of only five global centers with this capability, delivering comprehensive solutions in 3D measurement, reverse engineering, and dimensional compliance.

alliance.subtitle: Strategic Alliance
alliance.title: Where global standards converge with industrial excellence.
alliance.intro: The CEM was established to meet a critical requirement of modern industry: reliable access to micrometer-level precision measurement and rigorous technical validation in compliance with the highest international standards.
alliance.paragraph: This technical cooperation brings together the optical and metrological leadership of Germany's Carl Zeiss — the global benchmark in this industry — with the infrastructure, faculty, and technical training power of SENAI. This synergy empowers aerospace, automotive, healthcare, and metalworking companies to find world-class technical support directly in Brazil, on par with Europe's leading industrial hubs.

hero.description: Dimensional inspection, optical metrology, computed tomography, 3D scanning, and reverse engineering solutions powered by ZEISS technology reliability and SENAI technical excellence.

dimensional.title: Measure. Compare. Verify.
dimensional.description: We utilize Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) for tactile inspection of linear dimensions, form, and complex geometric tolerances. With the ZEISS DuraMax, we handle general-tolerance projects (≥ 0.02 mm). For tighter requirements and high-demand geometries, we deploy the ultra-high-precision ZEISS PRISMO.

optical.title: High-resolution non-contact measurement.
optical.description: Using the ZEISS O-Inspect, we inspect sensitive parts and components that cannot undergo mechanical probing. The system combines optical and tactile measurement, alongside the DotScan sensor, capable of capturing the topography of reflective, transparent, or hard-to-read surfaces.

xray.title: See what cannot be seen.
xray.description: With ZEISS Bosello, we perform non-destructive testing to evaluate internal structures and discontinuities invisible to conventional methods, identifying defects based on material density.

scanning.title: Transform physical geometry into digital data.
scanning.description: We capture complex geometries with optical and laser precision to produce 3D models, perform nominal vs. actual comparison (CAD × scanned physical part), and map surface wear on operating components. The T-SCAN Hawk 2 provides portable on-site flexibility, while the ATOS Q delivers maximum point density.

cmm.title: Coordinate Measuring (CMM) & GD&T
cmm.headline: Sub-micrometric accuracy for critical geometries and rigorous geometric compliance.
cmm.overview: Service dedicated to 3D geometric and linear characterization of high-demand mechanical parts. Utilizing continuous-contact CMM systems (tactile scanning), we evaluate form, orientation, and location deviations according to ISO 1101 and ASME Y14.5 standards.
targetAudience: Precision machining and die & mold making facilities
Automotive OEMs and Tier 1 / Tier 2 suppliers
Aerospace and defense industries requiring formal traceability
Serial parts manufacturers requiring First Article Inspection (FAI)
applications: Dimensional and linear inspection of engine blocks and housings
Complete GD&T inspection (runout, circularity, flatness)
First Article Inspection (FAI) validation of machined components
Process repeatability and capability studies (Cp, Cpk)
deliverables: Nominal vs. actual numerical comparison with tolerance bands
Certificate of conformity signed by the technical lead

optica.title: Combined Optical & Tactile Inspection
optica.headline: High-resolution non-contact measurement for flexible components and micro-geometries.
optica.overview: Integrates high-definition optical cameras with telecentric lenses and continuous tactile probing on a single machine. Eliminates contact pressure deformation on elastomers, thin polymers, technical textiles, and electronic circuits.
targetAudience: Medical device, implant, and prosthesis manufacturers
Thin-walled injection molded plastic parts manufacturers
Electronics and precision micro-connector industries
Technical textile and polymer packaging sectors
applications: Non-contact inspection of micro-holes and sharp edges
Evaluation of micro-deformations and radii on elastic components
Rapid 2D/3D combined measurement in a single setup without reclamping
deliverables: Optical dimensional analysis report with magnified images
2D contour deviation maps against vector drawings (DXF/CAD)
Technical certificate of edge and profile conformity

raio-x.title: X-Ray Inspection & Structural Analysis
raio-x.headline: Internal volumetric investigation and integrity verification without sectioning or destroying samples.
raio-x.overview: 2D radioscopic inspection and non-destructive tomography to identify hidden internal discontinuities. Evaluates cast components, welds, and sealed assemblies based on material density and radiological absorption.
targetAudience: Aluminum, cast iron, and specialty alloy foundries
Manufacturers of critical welded assemblies for energy and oil & gas
Assemblers of sealed or shielded electromechanical devices
Forensic engineering and warranty failure analysis labs
applications: Detection of internal porosities, gas voids, shrinkage cavities, and cracks
Inspection of weld root penetration and quality
Component positioning verification inside sealed enclosures
Mapping of metallurgical inclusions and discontinuities
deliverables: High-resolution digital radiographs with defect and void identification
Porosity analysis report compliant with industrial standards

machines.software: ZEISS Bosello Integrated Software / ZEISS INSPECT X-Ray (CT-Ready)

digitalizacao-3d.title: 3D Optical Scanning & Color Map Analysis
digitalizacao-3d.headline: Full geometric capture to produce 3D STL meshes, CAD comparisons, and dimensional control.
digitalizacao-3d.overview: High-precision 3D scanning using structured blue light and portable laser triangulation. Converts any physical component into an accurate 3D polygon mesh (.STL / .OBJ), enabling direct nominal vs. actual comparison (CAD × scanned physical part), wear mapping, 3D printing, or serving as the baseline dataset for parametric Reverse Engineering (CAD).
targetAudience: Anyone holding a physical part who needs its 3D digital model (.STL)
Designers and makers requiring watertight meshes for 3D printing and prototyping
Maintenance teams and workshops creating digital archives or part replicas
Quality inspection teams needing CAD vs. scanned physical part 3D color-map reports
Projects needing a digitized mesh as the starting foundation for Reverse Engineering (CAD)
applications: Generation of watertight STL and OBJ meshes ready for 3D printing
3D color-map deviation analysis (Nominal CAD vs. actual scanned part via 3D scanners)
Surface wear mapping and material loss monitoring for operating components
On-site portable scanning for medium and large components in the field or plant
Rapid inspection of warpage, twist, and sheet metal deformation
High-density mesh baseline for parametric Reverse Engineering
deliverables: Cleaned, closed, and aligned polygonal mesh (.STL, .OBJ, .PLY)
3D color-map deviation report indicating material excess, deficit, and nominal deviations
Comparative dimensional report for freeform surfaces and wear degradation maps

engenharia-reversa.headline: Transforming raw scan data into production-ready parametric solid models for local manufacturing.
engenharia-reversa.overview: End-to-end engineering workflow to reconstruct 3D CAD models from physical parts lacking original drawings, exhibiting mechanical wear, or requiring domestic manufacturing substitution. Encompasses precision parametric modeling, optimization, and full technical documentation for component localization.

Mining, agribusiness, and energy operations with imported heavy machinery facing long lead times
High-performance product and prototype developers
Tool and mold manufacturers needing original or improved geometry recovery
applications: Parametric CAD modeling from polygon meshes (Mesh to CAD)
Localization and development of imported components for domestic sourcing
Recovery of worn or broken components with missing geometry reconstruction
Geometric adaptation for modernization and operational efficiency upgrades
Extraction of design intents, 2D cross-sections, and parametric feature trees
deliverables: Parametric solid and surface CAD models in STEP, IGES, or Parasolid formats
2D manufacturing technical drawings in PDF and DWG with GD&T
CAD deviation report comparing reconstructed model against measured scan mesh
Engineering dossier to support domestic manufacturing feasibility

confiabilidade-mro.title: Reliability, Virtual MRO Warehouse & Technical Training
confiabilidade-mro.headline: Strategic spare parts management, asset tree structuring, and operational reliability for industry.
confiabilidade-mro.overview: Integrated reliability engineering and digital readiness solutions designed to transform industrial maintenance management (MRO). Through rigorous equipment asset tree structuring and analytical criticality and recurrence matrices, we identify critical Class A items with low demand recurrence, enabling their digital cataloging in virtual warehouses for rapid on-demand replacement without the prohibitive carrying costs of idle physical stock. This domain also encompasses tribology-driven maintenance and lubrication schedules, failure root cause diagnostics, and specialized technical qualification backed by SENAI methodology and ZEISS technology.
confiabilidade-mro.trainingDirectNotice: Notice for Technical Training: For technical training proposals, professional development, or corporate in-company classes (in metrology, reverse engineering, maintenance, lubrication, and failure analysis), we recommend reaching out directly to laboratory management via phone, WhatsApp, or email for streamlined syllabus alignment and scheduling.

subServices.title: Virtual warehouse and critical spare parts identification.
subServices.description: We establish digital component repositories to eliminate physical stocks of high-cost, slow-moving spare parts. By deploying criticality and recurrence matrices, we isolate Class A critical parts with low historical demand frequency. These parts are 3D scanned and archived in a certified digital library, unlocking agile on-demand replacement or fast local manufacturing, eliminating immobilized capital without increasing downtime exposure.
applications: Criticality and recurrence matrix deployment for Class A low-demand items identification
Creation of digital MRO spare part libraries complete with 3D CAD data and manufacturing drawings
Physical vs. digital stocking strategies delivering substantial reductions in working capital
Seamless integration with additive manufacturing, precision machining, and reverse engineering

subServices.title: Equipment trees and item-by-item asset mapping.
subServices.description: We organize the complete hierarchical structure of complex machinery and entire industrial production lines. Conducting thorough item-by-item surveys of every assembly, module, and spare component with functional descriptions, reference codes, and technical specifications, we ensure full operational traceability for maintenance and PCM planning teams.
applications: Structuring hierarchical equipment asset trees fully compatible with CMMS and ERP platforms
Comprehensive item-by-item cataloging and dimensional surveying of industrial assets
Critical components mapping and early identification of hard-to-source imported spares
Standardized asset data baselines for maintenance planning and preventive spare strategies

subServices.title: Preventive maintenance plans and industrial lubrication routines.
subServices.description: We formulate and review systematic preventive maintenance programs and industrial lubrication routines grounded in tribological rigor. We evaluate friction points, operating load regimes, environmental factors, and lubricant properties to deliver standardized procedures that eliminate premature wear, extend Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF), and maximize plant asset reliability.
applications: Development and optimization of preventive/predictive maintenance plans and inspection routines
Lubrication point mapping, precise dosing calculation, and scientifically defined intervals
Rationalization and standardization of industrial lubricants to lower inventory costs and contamination
Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) for maintenance engineering and plant lubrication teams

subServices.title: Failure analysis, mechanical breakdowns, and root-cause diagnosis.
subServices.description: We investigate the root causes of unexpected mechanical fractures, fatigue cracking, corrosion, and abnormal component wear. Combining SENAI mechanical metallurgy experts with state-of-the-art ZEISS laboratory instrumentation (computed tomography for non-destructive internal inspection and 3D optical scanning for wear maps), we provide conclusive forensic engineering reports that permanently prevent failure recurrence.
applications: Root-cause determination of mechanical fractures, material fatigue, and structural overloads
Non-destructive computed tomography inspection for internal voids, cracks, and porosity
3D wear mapping comparing operating geometry against nominal CAD design data
Formal technical diagnostic reports with corrective directives and component redesign advice

subServices.title: Specialized technical training and tailored in-company cohorts.
subServices.description: We qualify industrial technical personnel through hands-on training delivered by certified SENAI instructors and ZEISS accredited metrology specialists. We offer applied courses in coordinate metrology (CMM), optical inspection, GD&T, 3D scanning, reverse engineering, asset reliability, and mechanical maintenance routines, available through open enrollments or custom in-company programs.
applications: Hands-on training in dimensional metrology, coordinate measuring machines (CMM), and GD&T
Practical qualification in 3D structured blue-light/laser scanning and polygon mesh inspection
Applied courses in industrial reliability, machinery lubrication, and maintenance management
Official professional certifications issued by the SENAI Ítalo Bologna Faculty
